name: Bach Dinh
kicker: A late-1800s villa, now a museum
summary: Stop at the white villa on the walk up Big Mountain, above the Front Beach side. Work started in 1898, and the house is now a museum of local artefacts, with gardens and verandas toward the sea. The museum’s own page prints two different hour blocks and no price. Confirm both at the door.
timeNeeded: A short stop on the hill walk
getThere: The hill path from the Front Beach side.
heroCaption: The white villa front, the garden stair, and the tiled eaves

notice.title: Two addresses and two clocks
notice.body: The museum prints the building at 4 Trần Phú. The relic list prints 6 Trần Phú. One hour line is split around midday on weekdays. Another says 8:00–17:00 Tuesday to Sunday. Closed Monday is implied by both.

body: Vietnam Tourism calls it a late-1800s house for the French governor, now a quiet museum, with gardens and verandas toward the sea. The catalogue says work started in 1898, in the same years as the Hanoi Opera House, Notre-Dame, and the Saigon Opera House, and cites decision 983VH/QĐ of 4 August 1992.

Use it as a stop on the way toward the summit. Vietnam Tourism prints the summit trek as 30 minutes. Time inside the house is not printed. Come in the afternoon, which is the hour that page gives the garden walk.

The French battery on Big Mountain is a separate relic. A frame of those cannons in the open, with the sea, was not the picture that could be tied to the battery rather than to this villa, so the guns are not a separate page. Read the door for the ticket and for which hour line is in force.

figures.caption: The villa from the corner, the whole white block in frame
figures.alt: Bach Dinh, the white colonial villa on Big Mountain in Vung Tau

gettingThere: Bach Dinh sits on Big Mountain above the Front Beach side. The hill path is the way Vietnam Tourism describes. The summit beyond the house is the 30-minute trek on that page. Minutes from Back Beach are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Front Beach
legs.body: Up the hill path toward the villa. The museum address is 4 Trần Phú. The relic list prints 6 Trần Phú. Walk minutes are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the Ho May station
legs.body: The cable-car station is 1A Trần Phú, on the same road. The walk between the station and the villa is not given a minute count. Check on arrival.

hours: Tue–Fri 7:30–11:30 and 13:30–17:00, Sat–Sun 7:30–17:00 on one line; Tue–Sun 8:00–17:00 on another. Confirm at the door.
closed: Monday, implied by both lines on the museum page. Confirm at the door.
admissionNote: The hours page prints no price. Check on arrival. Do not assume 4 Trần Phú and 6 Trần Phú are one ticket window. Both addresses are printed.
